description: A transparent-background PNG of one subject, from Qwen-Image-2.1's native RGBA output. The subject is wrapped in the vendor's alpha prompt (This is an RGBA image with transparency. <subject>. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.) by a compose_text step, so give it without a trailing period. The result stays image/png: a jpeg result would flatten the alpha onto white. 40 steps at 1024x1024, half the base's 2K, suits a cut-out; width and height must be multiples of 32. Qwen Research License: non-commercial use only.

variables.subject: a red apple with a green leaf

width.reason: Qwen-Image-2.1 rounds width/height down to a multiple of 32 (vae_scale_factor * 2), so an off-grid value would be silently shrunk - refused here instead

height.reason: Qwen-Image-2.1 rounds width/height down to a multiple of 32 (vae_scale_factor * 2), so an off-grid value would be silently shrunk - refused here instead

parts: This is an RGBA image with transparency.
. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.
